selected_problem: Fresh canonical main publishes a fixed Autonomous Mission status enum, but AutonomousMissionStore.update validated status only when patch.status was truthy. Explicit falsy values such as empty string, null, 0, or false bypassed both the enum gate and terminal-state gate and could be durably written.（最新规范主仓已经发布固定的 Autonomous Mission 状态枚举，但 AutonomousMissionStore.update 只在 patch.status 为真值时验证状态；空字符串、null、0、false 等显式假值会绕过枚举门与终态门并被持久化。）
changes: Detect explicit status patches by own-property presence rather than truthiness.（按字段是否显式存在而不是真值判断状态补丁。）
Apply terminal-state and published-enum checks to every explicit status value before persistence.（在持久化前，对每个显式状态值执行终态门与已发布枚举检查。）

truth_boundary: This cycle fixes explicit status-write validation only. Durable documents externally rewritten to an invalid truthy or falsy status remain a separate read-boundary question for fresh-main diagnosis.（本轮只修复显式状态写入验证；外部改写持久化文档为非法状态的读取边界仍属于后续 fresh-main 诊断问题。）
